policy: Initial reviewed promotion output oracle; no automatic baseline update. Original 21-API v0.3.0 oracle stays separate and frozen.
dynamicFields: store.metadata timestamps validated as ISO and checksum as 64 hex before replacing tokens; undefined is explicitly encoded.

semantics.input: Validated schema 2 synthetic Dataset; optional exact generatedAt.
semantics.output: Frozen six-field snapshot with provenance and SHA-256 checksum.
semantics.error: Invalid input/timestamp rejects with StateError status.
semantics.persistence: Read-only export; no upload or write.

semantics.input: Snapshot or explicitly supported legacy snapshot.
semantics.null: Null input invalid; nullable facts preserved.

semantics.output: READY plan or BLOCKED details with counts/schema/integrity/conflicts and binding hash.
semantics.error: Invalid or unsupported snapshots blocked; no write.
semantics.null: Snapshot fact nulls retained; absent inspection schema null.
semantics.identity: Shows overwrite/removal conflicts, no guessed merge.
semantics.period: Explicit migration only; source periods preserved.
semantics.persistence: Read-only plan bound to store revision; commit is separate.

semantics.input: Untampered READY preview and same compatible store.
semantics.identity: Restores explicit source IDs; no name matching.
semantics.persistence: Atomic compare-and-swap write; no partial restore.

semantics.input: Explicit CSV/JSON synthetic files, dataset, source/batch IDs, update fingerprints.
semantics.output: Immutable row outcomes/counts/actions/provenance and binding hash.
semantics.identity: Dependency ordering validates exact IDs and hospital scopes.
semantics.persistence: Read-only projected dataset, no partial write.

semantics.input: Untampered READY or REPEATED_IMPORT preview and store.
semantics.identity: Stable IDs preserved; no implicit merge.
semantics.persistence: Atomic compare-and-swap commits all files together.

semantics.error: Failed validation/transaction yields FAILED with no partial tasks.
semantics.null: Failed taskCount null; unlinked task refs null.
semantics.persistence: Activity+Task changes commit as one transaction.

semantics.input: Known entity type and stable ID.
semantics.error: Unknown type rejects; corrupted storage rejects.
semantics.period: N/A: retains record dates without interpreting them.

semantics.input: Known entity type and complete validated fact.
semantics.error: Invalid dataset or stale transaction does not commit.
semantics.identity: Same ID updates rather than duplicates.

semantics.input: Known entity type and stable ID.
semantics.output: Transaction result; resulting get is null.
semantics.error: Referenced identity deletion rejected by full dataset validation.
semantics.null: Missing target is a no-fact-change transaction.

semantics.persistence: Read-only; returned rows cannot mutate store.

semantics.input: Draft mutator plus optional expected revision.
semantics.null: Nullable facts retained; result may be undefined.
semantics.persistence: Validated atomic compare-and-swap with rollback on any failure.

semantics.identity: Source IDs restored; no inferred merge.
semantics.persistence: Compatibility wrapper performs preview+atomic commit; new clients should expose restorePreview to humans first.

semantics.identity: Dataset revision binds identities; no identities exposed.
semantics.period: N/A: storage timestamps do not replace fact periods.
semantics.persistence: Read-only envelope metadata; checksum detects integrity, not authenticity.

semantics.output: Resolved undefined, explicitly encoded in contract oracle.
semantics.persistence: Releases adapter resources; no fact write.
